BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE hybrid_application_result,hybrid_application_work,hybrid_evaluation_work IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_application_work) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_application_result) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE local_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'refusing rollback: durable hybrid application work, results and local recovery must be preserved';
 END IF;
END $$;
DROP TABLE hybrid_application_result;
DROP TABLE hybrid_application_work;
DROP FUNCTION protect_hybrid_application_result_immutable();
ALTER TABLE hybrid_evaluation_work DROP COLUMN local_reason;
COMMIT;
